explication: Hemi Network’s core daemons provide Bitcoin-node RPC and indexing, Bitcoin finality queries, PoP mining, and RPC balancing for Hemi execution nodes. The main user-facing path is an RPC request to tbcd, handled by its service and exposed through the TBC API; indexing and database components support node data queries. Other daemon capabilities are shown as separate branches. The graph follows documented capabilities and indexed imports; unsampled internals are omitted where their call relationships cannot be verified.
